description: This file defines an internal interface IStressTestGrain for Orleans grains used in unit testing, specifying asynchronous methods for stress testing operations.

methods.name: GetLabel
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a label string from the grain.

methods.name: SetLabel
methods.description: Asynchronously sets a label string on the grain.

methods.name: PingOthers
methods.description: Sends a ping to other grains identified by their long IDs.

methods.name: LookUpMany
methods.description: Performs a lookup of multiple grains based on destination address and grain IDs with ETags, returning detailed info.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends byte data to the grain.

methods.name: Echo
methods.description: Returns the same byte data sent to the grain.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping with byte data.

methods.name: PingWithDelay
methods.description: Sends a ping with byte data after a specified delay.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Retrieves a reference to the grain itself.
